answer: Proposed rule: each fresh image inspection of terrace erosion, lotus disease or jade cracks earns its assigned ID one listing-minute. Validators check outputs against hidden labels and credit each job once globally; failed checks earn no time. Credits cannot transfer or be reused. Shared inference and parallelism can reduce expense, not multiply credit. Hardware is reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Bad labels weaken checks; ownership is not proved. Ten IDs listed for ten minutes each need 10 x 10 = 100 distinct accepted inspections.
